VAR_INPUT
 DO_LOW : BOOL;
 AERATION_E_STOP_NC : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
 BLOWER_RUN : BOOL := FALSE;
 AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT : UINT := 0;
END_VAR
VAR
 StartDelayTimer : TON;
 Permit : BOOL;
 PreviousRun : BOOL; // maybe not needed
END_VAR

Implementation:
Permit := DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC;

StartDelayTimer(IN := Permit, PT := T#5S);

IF Permit AND StartDelayTimer.Q THEN
    // new run true
    IF NOT BLOWER_RUN THEN
        AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT := AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT + 1;
    END_IF
    BLOWER_RUN := TRUE;
ELSE
    BLOWER_RUN := FALSE;
END_IF
